title: Selector coordinate pair distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $\theta\in[-1,1]$. Draw two independent elements from $\pi$, then draw a correlated pair of signs with parameter $\theta$; apply each sign to the two drawn elements by selecting the first element for sign $1$ and the second for sign $-1$. The resulting pair of elements of $\Omega$ has the selector coordinate pair distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
